name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms reaching toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees. Slowly extend your opposite arm and leg toward the floor, then return to the starting position. Alternate sides.
coaching_cue: Press your lower back into the floor throughout — if it arches, you've gone too far.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back, moving too fast, holding the breath.
modification: Keep arms still and only move the legs, or reduce range of motion.
advanced_progression: Hold a light dumbbell in the extending hand.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Extend your right arm and left leg simultaneously until they're in line with your body. Hold briefly, then return. Alternate sides.
coaching_cue: Imagine balancing a glass of water on your lower back — don't let it tip.
common_mistakes: Rotating the hips, arching the back, rushing the movement.
modification: Extend only the arm or only the leg at a time.
advanced_progression: Add a 3-second hold at full extension or place a resistance band around your wrists.

name: Forearm Plank
instructions: Support your body on your forearms and toes with your body in a straight line from head to heels. Hold the position while breathing steadily.
coaching_cue: Tuck your tailbone slightly and squeeze your glutes to prevent your hips from sagging.
common_mistakes: Hips sagging or piking up, holding breath, looking up (straining neck).
modification: Drop to your knees for a modified plank.
low_impact_alternative: Incline plank with forearms on a bench.
advanced_progression: Hold for 45-60 seconds or add shoulder taps.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height. Stand sideways to the anchor, holding the band at your chest with both hands. Press the band straight out in front of you, resisting the rotation, then bring it back to your chest.
coaching_cue: Your goal is to NOT rotate — the band is trying to pull you sideways, and your core resists.
common_mistakes: Letting the torso rotate, locking the arms, standing too close to the anchor.
modification: Use a lighter band or stand closer to the anchor.
advanced_progression: Step further from the anchor or use a heavier band.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side propped up on your forearm, feet stacked. Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to feet. Hold.
coaching_cue: Push the floor away with your forearm and keep your hips stacked directly on top of each other.
common_mistakes: Hips dropping, rotating forward, holding breath.
modification: Bend the bottom knee to the floor for support.
low_impact_alternative: Modified side plank from the knees.
advanced_progression: Add a hip dip (lower and lift hips) or extend the top arm.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Stand tall and walk forward with controlled steps, keeping your core braced and shoulders level.
coaching_cue: Walk tall — imagine a string pulling you up from the crown of your head. Don't lean or sway.
common_mistakes: Leaning to one side, shrugging the shoulders, taking too-large steps.
modification: Use lighter weights or walk for a shorter duration.
advanced_progression: Increase weight or try single-arm carries for an anti-lateral-flexion challenge.

name: Quadruped Glute Kickback
instructions: Start on all fours. Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, press one foot toward the ceiling until your thigh is in line with your body. Lower with control and repeat.
coaching_cue: Keep your hips level and avoid arching your lower back. Squeeze your glute at the top.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back, swinging the leg, rotating the hips open.
modification: Reduce range of motion or keep the movement small.
advanced_progression: Add an ankle weight or resistance band around your thighs.
